column1: # Eshu skill aliases for repo installs.
# alias: the harness-visible skill directory name (Eshu's eshu-* canon).
# source: the kit skill directory under skills/eshu/ (or skills/core/).
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# The installer materializes each alias as a wrapper dir in the repo's
# .claude/skills and .codex/skills trees: SKILL.md carries the alias in
# its frontmatter `name:` with alias cross-links; every other file is
# symlinked from the source. Rows where alias and source are identical
